title: Cheap material
text: Cheap material. I liked it when it arrived, I gave it for a gift with a candle and I guess the candle glass and the mug banged together very so slightly and the mug broke...very weak ceramic/glass or whatever it’s made of.  Very embarrassing when the recipient opened her package.
